system.description: The character has learned to tend wounds. Any injury treated immediately (within ten minutes) heals at a rate of 1 health point per specialty level, provided the treated injury actually caused that health loss. The character can care for the sick and wounded so they recover faster than normal — though this requires the patient to rest and receive the necessary treatment throughout the day. The healer must spend at least two hours per care attempt on a patient; a successful Skill roll means the patient heals twice as fast.
system.summary: Attends to wounds quickly to speed recovery and cares for the sick and convalescent.
